name: servers
description: A collection of pre-built, open-source MCP servers maintained by the community and Anthropic.
readme:
# MCP Servers

Reference implementations of Model Context Protocol servers for filesystems, databases, and more. Self-hostable and extensible.

name: dify
description: An open-source LLM app development platform with RAG, agent workflows, and model management.
readme:
# Dify

Dify is a platform for building and operating generative AI applications. It supports RAG pipelines, agents, and one-click self-hosted deployment.

name: qdrant
description: Qdrant is a vector similarity search engine and vector database written in Rust.
readme:
# Qdrant

Qdrant is a vector database and similarity search engine. It is a self-hostable open-source alternative to managed vector services like Pinecone.
